hero.alt: The red-and-white high-speed catamaran ferry 'SANI 1' berthed alongside a covered gangway at a Langkawi jetty, with green limestone hills behind — the classic Malaysian passenger ferry to the islands. Strong left-side subject, open sky top-right for overlay.

A small covered Marine Park boat moored beside a stilted island jetty in clear turquoise water at Perhentian Besar — the last-mile island hop by small boat. Adds a second island-transport scene distinct from the car-ferry hero and the terminal body.

hero.alt: The actual ECRL rolling stock: a blue-and-silver CR200J electric trainset with the ECRL flower logo on its nose, standing on depot tracks (a yellow KTM Komuter set beside it). The one ECRL-specific train photo on Commons — unmistakably this new east-coast line. Wide landscape, train filling the right of frame.

body.alt: The twin tunnel portals of 'Terowong 2 Serendah' bored into a green hillside, with the MRL/ECRL project banner above and new ballasted track emerging in the foreground — the line being built through the Titiwangsa range. Documentary infrastructure shot (2025).

An ECRL viaduct under construction at Sungai Tua — concrete piers rising on a cleared hillside with a launched box-girder span behind the site hoarding. Shows the elevated-alignment stage of the project, distinct from the tunnel body and the finished trainset hero.

hero.alt: Mature oil-palm estate climbing a hillside with an estate road, Kunak District, Sabah — unmistakably oil palm, 16:9, clean sky band for overlay.

body.alt: A palm-oil mill complex (blue sheds + steaming chimneys) set amid hills of oil palm — the processing side of the business. No people.
A tipper truck heaped with fresh fruit bunches (FFB) at a mill gate ('Kilang Apas Balung') — the harvest/logistics leg. Only a tiny, non-identifiable worker at frame edge.

hero.alt: An aerial view of a KTM ETS intercity electric train running along the West Coast main line through green countryside, with housing estates and a playground below — 'moving around Malaysia' by fast national rail. Clean daylight establishing shot, train crossing the upper third.

body.alt: A driver's-eye view of the Karak Expressway approaching the Karak Interchange, green gantry signs pointing to Temerloh, Kuantan and 'Lebuhraya Pantai Timur', with a motorcyclist and cars — getting around Malaysia by road. Adds the highway/driving mode distinct from the rail images.

A KTM ETS Class 93 intercity train in a colourful campaign livery drawn up at a modern elevated platform (Sungai Buloh), catenary overhead — the station/boarding view of Malaysian intercity rail. Distinct context from the hero's open-country aerial.

body.alt: A blue-green GO KL free electric city bus pulling in at a kerbside stop/shelter ('100% Clean Energy / Perkhidmatan Bas Percuma') — a bus-at-a-stop view and a distinct livery/mode. Two tiny, non-identifiable commuters at the shelter.
A clean side-profile of a single-deck Rapid KL bus (red/cream/blue livery) at KL Sentral — complements the double-decker hero and electric GO KL body. No faces.

hero.alt: A sleek red-and-white MRT Putrajaya Line train on an elevated viaduct against a dramatic sky — modern Klang Valley metro, strong sky band for overlay.

body.alt: Clean modern underground MRT platform (Tun Razak Exchange) with platform-screen doors and a train-arrival display — the station-interior view. No identifiable faces.

KL Monorail train curving on its elevated guideway past a mosque and the city skyline — adds a second rail mode and Klang Valley context. Distinct from hero (elevated metro) and body-1 (underground station).
